data_classification: synthetic demonstration only; team-level aggregates, no agent-level records

grains.RAW.TEAMS: one row per fictional BPO agent team (city, line of business, risk tier, average tenure)
grains.RAW.TEAM_DAILY: one row per team per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.TRAINING_RECORDS: one row per team (compliance training snapshot)
grains.CURATED.EVENT_TYPE_SUMMARY: one row per workforce event type

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.gap_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(staffing-gap event on the team in the next 7 days), evaluated on an out-of-time holdout
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day company-wide workforce-event FORECAST; unplanned absence ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.WORKFORCE_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic staffing-response SOPs (one per line of business and event type)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.WORKFORCE_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.WORKFORCE_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, team, event-type and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (teams, daily workforce events, staffing gaps by team, staffing-gap risk, staffing events loaded) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: Amazon Data Firehose -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_STAFFING_EVENTS
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_GAP_ALERT logs new GAP events to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)

aws.memo: Amazon Bedrock Claude Sonnet 4.5 via APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE
